title: Airport Flex Park broker underwriting
summary: Airport Flex Park · Prepared by the seller's broker

evidence.quote: Fictional Industrial Partners underwrites in-place net operating income of $486,000.
At the price of $7,200,000 that is a capitalization rate of 6.75%.
The buyer's own underwriting has year-one net operating income of $462,412, a going-in capitalization rate of 6.42%.
